title: The Distant Echo
author: Isandro Joubert
blurb: Vesper Okafor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
